name: ai-skills
description: Skills for Claude Code: new-app scaffolds a new multi-platform product on our standard stack; check-updates audits outdated packages, SDKs, CI tasks, images, machine tools and VS Code extensions; security-scan finds vulnerable dependencies and images, leaked secrets, insecure IaC and CI, and vulnerable code. tech-news gathers recent news, releases, advisories and deprecations for the technologies a repo uses. feature-baseline checks a repo for baseline features such as authentication, account deletion, report and block, terms, privacy, budget alerts, Google and Apple login, change password, feedback and analytics.
